product_one_liner.value: Alice (formerly ActiveFence) is the trusted partner for organizations building GenAI applications, AI agents, and foundation models, helping them test, protect, and monitor their AI systems against adversarial attacks, jailbreaks, prompt injection, unsafe outputs, and policy violations across the full deployment lifecycle.
product_one_liner.notes: Directly stated on the Alice LLM product page; WonderSuite platform page confirms it targets teams launching customer-facing AI.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation and footer list Product, Solutions, Resources, and Company links but no pricing link; TrustRadius states Alice has no pricing plans listed and directs visitors to the product page; the site uses a 'Book a demo' contact flow.

named_customers.notes: Customer list on alice.io/llm names Amazon, Anthropic, AWS, Black Forest Labs, Cohere, Deliveroo, Google, Lovable, Meta, Niantic, NVIDIA, Riot Games, TikTok, Udemy; Calcalist independently confirms clients including Amazon, TikTok, Nvidia, Cohere, Black Forest Labs.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn company page lists company size 201-500 employees; Crustdata (Sep 2026) reports 439 employees.

hq_location.notes: Company identity block: 'Headquarters New York, USA and Tel Aviv, Israel'; LinkedIn lists HQ New York.

founded_year.notes: Company identity block states 'Founded 2018'; the About page says 'Your Trusted Partner (Since 2018)'.

eng_blog.notes: 'Engineering @ Alice' Medium publication with multiple engineering posts by engineers (Principal Engineer Jonathan Lavon's data-lake architecture post, data-model construction, Databricks guardrails post); linked from alice.io as 'Engineering'.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation site docs.alice.io (linked as 'Docs' in the homepage footer) contains multiple sections: WonderFence guides, API reference, and an integrations catalog (agent frameworks, gateways, SDKs on PyPI).

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live careers page lists open roles including Principal Data Scientist (R&D, Ramat Gan), Senior AI Engineer, GenAI Security Researcher, Adversarial AI Research Scientist (Red Team), and Data Science Engineering Manager; the Principal Data Scientist posting (dated Nov 4, 2026 cache) describes LLM-as-judge, MLflow/Triton MLOps work.

model_provider.value: The product runs on Alice's own proprietary 'ActiveFence AI' transformer that powers WonderFence, and is model-agnostic across OpenAI, Anthropic, Llama, Databricks, and self-hosted models (internally built on a multi-provider LLM foundation: Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, xAI Grok).
model_provider.notes: Company blog names the proprietary ActiveFence AI transformer powering WonderFence; the integrations FAQ states WonderFence is model-agnostic and works across OpenAI, Anthropic, Llama, Databricks, and self-hosted models; a live job posting names Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, xAI Grok as its LLM foundation.

compliance_certs.notes: The homepage badge area shows SOC 2 CERTIFIED, HIPAA COMPLIANT and ISO 27001 badges (plus ISO 42001, which is outside the five asked); the LLM page states 'Alice is certified to SOC 2 and ISO 27001.'

last_funding.notes: Blog dated Aug 25, 2026: 'Alice raised $140M led by Apax Digital'; Dealroom describes it as a $140M Series D at $800M valuation; TNW confirms Aug 25, 2026 announcement bringing total funding to $280M.

raised_18mo.notes: $140M round led by Apax Digital announced Aug 25, 2026, well inside the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live posting 'Sales Development Representative | Alice Careers' (New York, USA, $130k-$148k OTE) on alice.io/positions; also listed on Grove Ventures' job board (posted Aug 10, 2026), and a Sales Executive role appears on the careers page.

launched_6mo.notes: Blog index shows 'ALICE WonderFence is now a Databricks Unity AI Gateway External Policy' dated Oct 12, 2026 and an AWS Strands Agents integration post Oct 6, 2026; a dated Oct 15, 2026 announcement covers the NVIDIA Nemotron safety collaboration; all inside the 6-month window ending 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The About page's leadership section (small, fully checkable) lists the current C-level roster (CEO Noam Schwartz, CTO Iftach Orr, CFO Adi Zaidel, CPEO Avi Golan, COO Zohar Cohen, CRO John O'Donnell) with no join dates inside the window and no departure announcement was found; LinkedIn (refreshed 2026-10-31) shows the CRO still current at Alice since 2023-11. The most recent dated C-level move found was CPO Amit Elisha's June 2025 departure (before the window).

crm_stack_signal.notes: Alice's own SDR job posting lists under Tech Stack: 'Hands-on experience with CRM platforms and sales engagement tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, Salesloft).'
